scope: Proposition 8.4 (Strengthened surface stability) of the manuscript “A positive resolution of De Giorgi's conjecture in dimension eight” (preprints/De-Giorgis-conjecture-in-dimension-eight-September-26-2026/article.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 375 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6c92e90f31e12f32), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 52. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each ε > 0, choose P sufficiently large as in Lemma 8.1. There exists δ > 0 such that every compactly supported Lipschitz function on {z ∈ Σ : D(z) < δ} satisfies (1 − ε) ∫ Σ a2 + IP 2 ψ2 dS ≤ ∫ Σ |∇Σψ|2 dS. (8.4) In the lifted computation the gradient coefficient can be made arbitrarily close to σ, and the negative coefficient arbitrarily close to σ(a2 + IP )/2, with the same choices.
